text: 港股开盘，恒生指数涨1.0%，恒生科技指数涨1.02%。个股方面，齐云山食品涨9.94%，亚盛医药涨6.85%，巨子生物涨6.66%，嘉耀控股涨4.98%，小菜园涨4.73%。
text_en: Hong Kong stocks opened with the Hang Seng Index up 1.0% and the Hang Seng Tech Index up 1.02%. Among individual stocks, Qiyunshan Food rose 9.94%, Ascentage Pharma rose 6.85%, Giant Biogene rose 6.66%, Jiayao Holdings rose 4.98%, and Xiaocaiyuan rose 4.73%.
